description: Jane Namaganda-Kiyimba and colleagues at Makerere University, Europa-Universität Flensburg and SINTEF Energy Research publish data for a model-based study of Uganda’s energy future. The source links the Uganda case-study branch of a GENeSYS-MOD training repository. Five XLSX descriptors identify an hourly dataset and four input workbooks combining BAU or NetZero with With or Without labels. The metadata does not explain what those latter alternatives include. Together the files form one national energy-system planning input collection. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. Scenario years, geographical aggregation, numerical variables and the observed period behind the hourly data are not specified. The related GENeSYS-MOD record describes the model family. No workbooks or repository bodies were read, and the deposit does not independently establish model accuracy or realised transition outcomes.
